title: Single Molecule Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization Using RNAscope in Zebrafish Embryo and Larva
author: Léa Torcq
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Prepare 50× PTU solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 750 mg N‑Phenylthiourea powder in 500 mL mQ H₂O, heat to 50 °C with magnetic stirring overnight in a dark container; store at room temperature for weeks.

steps.title: Prepare 25× Tricaine solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g Tricaine powder in 250 mL mQ H₂O, stir overnight at room temperature, aliquot 15 mL into Falcon tubes and freeze at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10× PBS stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 98.9 g PBS 10× powder in 0.95 L mQ H₂O, bring to 1 L with additional water; this yields a 10× PBS concentrate.

steps.title: Prepare 1× PBS and PBST
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 mL of the 10× PBS stock with 900 mL mQ H₂O to obtain 1 L of 1× PBS. Mix 49.750 mL of 1× PBS with 0.250 mL Tween 20 to make 1× PBS + 0.1 % Tween 20 (PBST).

steps.title: Prepare fixation solution
steps.instruction: Combine 4 mL of 10 % formaldehyde (to give 4 % final), 5.6 mL PBST, and 0.4 mL of the 25× Tricaine stock (1/25 final) to a total of 10 mL; keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare methanol series
steps.instruction: Make 25 % MeOH (2.5 mL 100 % MeOH + 7.5 mL mQ H₂O), 50 % MeOH (5 mL MeOH + 5 mL water), and 75 % MeOH (7.5 mL MeOH + 2.5 mL water), each in 10 mL total volume.

steps.title: Prepare proteinase K solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the 20 mg/mL glycerol stock of Proteinase K 1 : 2000 in PBST (final activity 10 µg/mL). Keep aliquots at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare RNAscope probe dilutions
steps.instruction: For each channel (C1, C2, C3) dilute probe 1 : 50 in Probe Diluent (PD): add 2 µL probe to 98 µL PD (total 100 µL). Mix channels as required (e.g., C1 + C2 + C3 = 96 µL C1 + 2 µL C2 + 2 µL C3).

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer and OPAL dye
steps.instruction: Dilute 50× WB 1 : 50 with mQ H₂O (1 mL 50× + 49 mL water). Dilute each OPAL dye 1 : 500 by mixing 1 µL dye with 499 µL TSA buffer (final volume 500 µL per sample).

steps.title: Prepare low‑melting agarose
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g low‑melting agarose in 50 mL 1× PBS to obtain 2 % (w/v) agarose; keep at 85 °C until use. Also prepare 1 % agarose in PBST by mixing 0.5 g agarose with 50 mL PBST if needed for later mounting.

steps.title: Collect and dechorionate embryos
steps.instruction: Raise zebrafish embryos in Volvic water containing methylene blue (1500 mg/L) and PTU (0.003 % final) at 28.5 °C. At 35–48 hpf manually dechorionate embryos; anesthetize 48–50 hpf embryos or 5 dpf larvae with tricaine 1 : 25 (≈160 µg/mL).

steps.title: Fix embryos and store in methanol
steps.instruction: Place up to 15–20 embryos/larvae per 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 1 mL fixation solution, rock gently at room temperature for 2–2.5 h. Wash twice with 1 mL PBST, discard supernatant, add 1.5 mL 100 % MeOH, and store tubes at –20 °C.

steps.title: Rehydrate embryos through MeOH series
steps.instruction: Allow embryos to settle by gravity, then sequentially add 1 mL of 75 % MeOH, 50 % MeOH, and 25 % MeOH (each 10 min, rocking at RT). After the last step, wash twice with 1 mL PBST.

steps.title: Quench endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Remove PBST, add 75 µL of the H₂O₂ solution from the Multiplex Fluorescent Reagent kit (three 25 µL drops) to each tube, incubate 10 min on a rocking platform at RT, then discard the solution.

steps.title: Permeabilize with proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of the 1 : 2000 Proteinase K solution in PBST to each tube. Incubate embryos for 7 min or larvae for 40 min at 37 °C on a dry heating block; for larvae, tap tubes gently every 10 min. Remove solution carefully under a binocular.

steps.title: Wash post‑permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash twice with 1 mL PBST for 10 min each at RT on a rocking platform (gravity sedimentation between washes).

steps.title: Hybridize probes
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL PD to each tube, rock at 40 °C for at least 2 h. Remove excess PD, add 50–100 µL of the appropriate probe dilution(s), and incubate overnight at 40 °C (do not agitate; tap tubes gently before incubation).

steps.title: Signal amplification and fluorophore coupling
steps.instruction: Perform the following substeps on Day 2:

substeps.instruction: Pre‑warm 50× WB 10 min at 30 °C, shake, then dilute 1 : 50 with water.
Wash twice with 1 mL WB for 10 min each at RT on a rocking platform.
Add 50 µL AMP1, incubate 30 min at 40 °C; wash twice with WB 10 min each.
Add 50 µL AMP2, incubate 30 min at 40 °C; wash twice with WB 10 min each.
Add 50 µL AMP3, incubate 15 min at 40 °C; wash twice with WB 10 min each.
Add 50 µL RNAscope FL v2 HRP‑C (channel‑specific, e.g., HRP‑C3), incubate 15 min at 40 °C; wash twice with WB 10 min each.
Add 100 µL TSA buffer, incubate 10 min at 40 °C.
Add 500 µL diluted OPAL dye (1 : 500), incubate 30 min at 40 °C; wash twice with WB 10 min each.
Add 50 µL HRP blocker, incubate 15 min at 40 °C; wash twice with WB 10 min each.
Keep embryos in PBST until mounting (optional DAPI staining can be performed after the blocker step).

steps.title: Mount embryos in agarose
steps.instruction: On Day 3, under a binocular:

substeps.instruction: Wash embryos twice for 10 min in PBST with gentle rocking at RT.
Transfer up to 6–7 embryos/larvae into a 60 µm‑bottom Ibidi dish (max 1 mL total volume; add PBST to reach 1 mL if needed).
Using a 25G needle, remove the eye facing the glass and any protruding tissue.
Remove excess medium, add 1 mL PBST.
Move embryos to the centre/bottom of the dish with a trimmed microloader tip.
Melt 2 % low‑melting agarose at 85 °C, mix 1 mL agarose with the 1 mL PBST containing the embryos, gently pipette to avoid disturbing orientation, and allow to solidify.
Store the dish protected from light at 4 °C; imaging can be performed the next day or up to 2 days later.

steps.title: Confocal imaging
steps.instruction: Acquire z‑stack series covering the whole region of interest using appropriate laser lines (e.g., 570 nm for OPAL‑570). Keep images in the linear detector range; do not adjust brightness/contrast for quantitative spot counting.
